.evWrap {position:relative; width:100%; overflow:hidden; z-index:0; font-family:Pretendard, 'Noto Sans Regular', sans-serif; background:#fff;}
.evWrap p, .evWrap ul, .evWrap ol, .evWrap li, .evWrap h3 {margin:0; padding:0;}
._evt_hide {position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; margin:0; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;}
._info_visual ._text {position:absolute; left:0; top:26.66667vw; width:100%; text-align:center; font-size:3.06667vw; font-weight:500; color:#000;}
._info_nav_flex ._nav_wrap {width:100%; height:14.53333vw; border-bottom:0.13333vw solid #000; box-sizing:border-box; background:#fff; z-index:100;}
._info_nav_flex ._nav_inner {display:flex; justify-content:center; width:100%; height:100%; margin:0 auto; padding:0 3.73333vw; box-sizing:border-box; text-align:center;}

._info_nav_flex ._nav_wrap ._nav a {position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:100%; padding:0 4.33333vw; box-sizing:border-box; color:#888; font-size:4vw; font-weight:600;}
._info_nav_flex ._nav_wrap ._nav._current a::before {content:''; position:absolute; left:4.4vw; right:4.4vw; bottom:-0.13333vw; height:0.8vw; background:#000; z-index:0;}
._info_nav_flex._fixed ._nav_wrap {position:fixed; left:50%; top:50px;/* <<<<<50 px 단위 고정 */ transform:translateX(-50%);}
._nav_content ._anchor {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-direction:column; gap:2.53333vw; color:inherit; position:relative;}
._nav_content ._anchor ._anchor_tit {display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1.86667vw; padding:0 5.33333vw; text-align:center; font-weight:700; font-size:8vw; line-height:1.2; letter-spacing:-0.03em;}

._nav_content ._prd_banner ._top_slider ._item ._item_wrap {position:relative; transform:scale(0.888) translateX(0); display:block; width:86.66667vw; height:60vw; margin:0 auto; border-radius:2.66667vw; overflow:hidden; background:#4A4A4A; transition:transform 0.4s;}

._nav_content ._prd_banner ._top_slider ._item ._indicator {position:absolute; right:5.33333vw; bottom:5.06667vw; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:0.8vw; font-size:3.2vw; line-height:5.33333vw; color:#fff; opacity:0; transition:opacity 0.4s;}

._nav_content ._brand_keywords > span {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-start; gap:0.66666vw; padding:0 3.2vw 0 3.33333vw; height:8.66667vw; border-radius:8.66667vw; background-color:#C8292E; color:#fff; font-size:3.73333vw; font-weight:700; text-align:center;}
._nav_content ._product_item ._item_panel ._item_obj ._item a {display:flex; flex-direction:column; position:relative; width:100%; height:100%; color:#312B45;}

._nav_content ._product_item ._item_panel ._item_obj ._item ._thumb {display:flex; justify-content:center; flex:0 0 auto; align-items:center; width:100%; height:27.2vw; background:#fff; border-radius:1.33333vw;}

._nav_content ._product_item ._item_panel ._item_obj ._item ._desc {display:-webkit-box; min-height:6.66667vw; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; -webkit-line-clamp:2; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; margin-top:1.06667vw; font-size:3.33333vw; font-weight:400; line-height:1.2; letter-spacing:-0.03em;}

._nav_content ._brand_tag ._tag {display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; height:8.66667vw; padding:0 3.06667vw 0 3.06667vw; border-radius:8.66667vw; border:0.13333vw solid #fff; font-size:3.73333vw; font-weight:500; color:#fff; line-height:1.2; cursor:pointer;}
._nav_content ._brand_wrap ._brand_item a {display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; width:100%; padding:0 0 3.33333vw 0; text-align:center;}

._nav_content ._brand_wrap ._brand_item ._more {display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; width:37.33333vw; height:6.66667vw; margin-top:2.26667vw; background:#000; font-size:2.66667vw; font-weight:500; line-height:1.3; color:#fff;}

._nav_content ._benefit_tag ._tag {display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; width:auto; height:8.66667vw; padding:0 3.2vw; white-space: nowrap; border-radius:8.66667vw; border:0.13333vw solid #fff; font-size:3.73333vw; font-weight:500; color:#fff; line-height:1.2; cursor:pointer;}

._nav_content ._benefit_wrap ._benefit_list ._benefit_item ._btn > span {display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:1.6vw; height:6.66667vw; padding:0.26667vw 2.26667vw 0 2.4vw; border:0.26667vw solid #fff; border-radius:6.66667vw; font-size:3.2vw; font-weight:500; line-height:1.2; color:#fff;}
._nav_content ._benefit_wrap ._benefit_list ._benefit_item ._btn > span i {position:relative; left:0; top:-0.13333vw; width:4vw; height:4vw;}
